items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I know, we played together because he showed me pictures of it. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, in El Paso.

ctx.x: And my name is Dick Allen. I think he's picking us up all right now. And where are we anyway? What's the address? 418 North Prairie. North Prairie. And this is your home where you're living now. But you knew each other somewhere else before. I know, we played together because he showed me pictures of it.
